The cycle detection logic currently fails to detect self-loops (cycles of length 1 where a node has a prerequisite to itself). When `edge.to === start` and `edgePath.length === 0`, the condition `edgePath.length > 0` evaluates to `false`, causing the self-loop to be ignored. Removing `&& edgePath.length > 0` allows self-loops to be correctly identified as cycles.

```suggestion
      if (edge.to === start) {
```
